description: 代际替换下三资源三 token 共同通信协议的保真度与漂移
research_question: 已经形成的三槽位共同协议，在不同伙伴覆盖的代际学习中能否被新主体保留；资源槽位、组合成功率和符号形式如何共同变化？

transmission.rotating_AB: A and B alternate by global update parity
transmission.random_ABC: A, B and C sampled by a deterministic schedule
transmission.newcomer_training: communication modules only; residents and private visual encoders frozen

measurement.generation_one_to_four: after one newcomer is trained and replaces identity 0, 1, 2, 3 respectively

controls_and_limits: private visual encoders are inherited from v0.28 and frozen throughout
formation endpoints are copied from the sealed v0.39 teacher-free experiment
only the held newcomer's sender and receiver communication heads are reset and optimized
four agents, six sites, three resources and experimenter-defined topology schedules are a controlled mechanism probe
a three-token grounded tuple is a compositional communication probe, not open-ended natural language
